inbox.title: Approvals

empty.decide: Nothing is waiting for your decision.

waiting.minute: {count, plural, =0 {Waiting less than a minute} one {Waiting # minute} other {Waiting # minutes}}

closed.rejected: This request was rejected. No further decision is needed.

verdict.own_request: You made this request, so someone else must decide it.
verdict.about_you: This request is about you, so someone else must decide it.
verdict.limit: This request is above your approval limit. It needs an approver with a higher limit.
verdict.already_decided: You already decided an earlier stage. A different approver must decide this stage.

errors.WORKFLOW_MISSING: This request has no approval route configured. Contact an administrator.

errors.COMMENT_REQUIRED: Please write a comment (at least 3 characters) when rejecting.
errors.VALIDATION: Please check the values you entered.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
